name: recheck-v2
description: Closed-checklist recheck of a build doc's punch list: a fresh verifier proves each named BLOCKER or MAJOR fix landed and the slice's card moves. Takes recorded findings from a build doc's punch list, a caller-held verdict's named findings, or docs/punch-list.md; never for findings nobody recorded. Pilot of the skills v2 core: one portable body plus a small adapter per harness (E9); the -v2 suffix stays while v1 recheck is installed and both are renamed at cutover.
